Interest Rate Risk We have exposure to changes in interest rates on our debt, as follows: Term Loan Facility . As of December 31, 2025, we had an aggregate principal amount outstanding of $985 million on our Term Loan Facility. The interest rate fluctuates based on the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (&#8220;SOFR&#8221;) or a Base Rate, as defined in the agreement, plus an applicable margin. Assuming an average annual aggregate principal amount outstanding of $985 million, a hypothetical 1% increase in the interest rate would have increased our annual interest expense by $10 million.
